transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because… my thinking just feels like it stops. At work I’ll have a test report open, or even a simple CAD note, and I can sit there for an hour not knowing what sentence to write next or what box to check. It’s been getting hard to function.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really thought of it as “sad.” Mostly I just feel off. Kind of shut down.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I’m not sure. I mean… I get tense sometimes, but I haven’t really been thinking of it as anxiety.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really. I used to like doing my miniature prints, but there’s one just sitting there half-finished for months. Even yoga or going for walks in the woods just feels like… another thing I’m supposed to do.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
I haven’t really been keeping track. My clothes feel about the same, I think.
Do you feel like you're able to experience pleasure when you do things?

Not really. Even things I used to like… my miniature printer’s just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure for months. Yoga, walks in the woods… it all kind of feels like another chore now.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual?

Yeah… I think so. At work, people have started finishing my sentences in meetings because I take too long to answer. And even just walking from my desk to the test chamber feels… really slow, like I’m moving through thick syrup.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um… I guess since I got moved into the prototype-testing role. That was about… a year and a month ago.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?

Yeah… some. I don’t really… plan anything, but on my commute I’ll catch myself thinking it’d be easier if I just didn’t get anywhere. And sometimes the thought of steering off the road comes up, and it scares me enough that I pull over for a minute.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better?
I don’t know… not really. Maybe little moments where I’m distracted, but I wouldn’t say I felt better exactly.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt completely back to normal?
No… I don’t think so. It’s kind of just been there since that role change, about a year ago. I haven’t felt like myself, not fully.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you didn't get out of bed?

Not whole days, no. I get up, but… it’s slow. At work people have started finishing my sentences in meetings because I take too long, and even just walking to the test chamber feels like I’m moving through syrup.
Have you had any periods in the last month where you felt even slightly better than you do now?
I’m not sure… maybe small bits where I’m occupied and not thinking about it as much. But I wouldn’t say I felt better, really.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past year?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been tracking it… my clothes seem about the same, I guess.
Have you had any periods in the last year where your symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?
Not really worse than now… it’s been kind of like this since I got moved into the prototype-testing role, about a year and a month ago.
Have you had any periods in the last year where you felt even slightly better than you do now for at least two weeks?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been pretty much going on since they moved me into that prototype-testing role, like… a little over a year ago.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt even slightly better for more than a couple of days?
No… not really. It’s just been kind of the same since I got moved into that prototype-testing role… about a year and a month ago.
Have you felt like you're moving more quickly than usual at any point in the last year?

No… if anything it’s the opposite. I feel really slowed down. People at work have started finishing my sentences in meetings because I take too long to answer. Even just walking to the test chamber feels… heavy, like I’m moving through syrup.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt nearly back to your normal self?
No. I don’t think so… it’s just been like this since I got moved into that prototype-testing role, about a year and a month ago.
Would you say your symptoms have been consistently severe over the past two weeks?
Yeah… pretty much. It’s been like this for a long time now — since I got moved into that prototype-testing role, about a year and a month ago.
